map.pH 是对数指标，同样降 0.1 个 pH 单位，酸性土所需石灰远多于中性土，因: pH is a logarithmic scale, so dropping 0.1 pH unit requires far more lime in an acidic soil than in a neutral one, because soils buffer. The dosage must therefore follow the buffering curve rather than the raw difference.
map.→ 打开土壤pH值调节计算器工具: -> Open the soil pH adjustment calculator tool
map.不建议一次大剂量。大调幅应分 2~3 年施用，并翻耕混匀，避免局部碱化烧根。施后: A single large dose is not recommended. A large adjustment should be split over 2-3 years and tilled in evenly to avoid local alkalisation burning the roots. Re-test the pH after 2-4 weeks before deciding on a top-up.
map.为什么测的是 pH 不是酸度？: Why is pH measured rather than acidity?
map.依据当前土壤 pH 与目标值，计算石灰或硫磺等调理剂用量，适用于酸化/碱化土壤改: Based on the current soil pH and the target value, it computes the amount of lime or sulfur conditioner, for improving acidified or alkalised soils, adjusting the tillage layer and improving crop suitability.

map.石灰一次撒够吗？: Is one application of lime enough?
map.石灰用量 ≈ 目标 pH 与现状差值 × 土壤缓冲容量 × 面积（经验曲线查表）: Lime requirement ≈ the difference between the target and current pH × the soil buffering capacity × the area (from an empirical curve table).

map.酸化菜地调 pH: Adjusting the pH of acidified vegetable land
map.酸性土施石灰升 pH，碱性土施硫磺降 pH。: Apply lime to raise pH in acidic soils and sulfur to lower pH in alkaline soils.
map.：现状 pH 5.2，目标 6.5，差值 1.3；粘壤土缓冲较强，经验石灰需要量: : current pH 5.2 and target 6.5 give a difference of 1.3; a clay loam buffers strongly, with an empirical lime requirement of about 150 kg/(mu·pH), so this time ≈ 1.3 × 150 ≈ 195 kg/mu. Sandy soil buffers weakly, so halve the amount.
